messages:
elaine: Quick heads-up — soft freeze starts in ~2h (21:00 UTC). Please file any late-merge exception requests in this thread. Include PR link, short risk blurb, and a rollback plan. release-bot will block auto-merges at cutoff. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

alex: FYI PR #5123 — node dep bump + changelog. small change, tests green locally. can I request an exception? link: https://github.com/redwood/pr/5123

sarah: If it isn't a bugfix i'd prefer to hold it for the next release. what's the reason for bump now?

alex: Staging runs started failing intermittently against current dep; this bump fixes CI flakes and reduces noise. not a user-facing change but CI unblock -> faster rollouts.

jonah: If it actually stabilizes CI we can consider. Can you paste the minimal rollback command and a brief test plan?

alex: Rollback is one-liner: ```bash
git revert --no-commit 9f8c7b1 && git commit -m "revert: dep bump #5123" && git push```. Test plan: run e2e-staging (10m), smoke on canary (5m). I added changelog entry in the PR.

elaine: Thanks @alex. That looks reasonable — please add the rollback snippet to the PR description and tag @dev-oncall. I'm going to triage exceptions after the next CI pass. Also include the approximate deploy window if merged.

ci-bot: build #987 for PR 5123 re-run -> ✅ all checks passed (10m ago)

release-bot: Reminder: soft-freeze mode will apply per-repo at cutoff 2191237200 UTC. Auto-merge is disabled; exceptions must be approved in this thread and include a rollback plan. See docs: https://confluence.redwood/release-exceptions

dev-oncall: I'm on it — will review the PR and confirm quick smoke after merge if approved. If we need to block, I'll post back within 30m.

sarah: If @dev-oncall signs off and the rollback plan exists, I'm fine approving. :+1:

alex: added rollback snippet and deploy window (21:15-21:25 UTC) to the PR description. pinging @release-bot for manual exception approval.

elaine: OK — final ask: keep the release notes entry minimal, mark as internal CI fix. If anything looks risky during canary, we'll revert immediately with the command above. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:

jonah: Noted. If we merge, I'll watch the canary and post an update in #incidents if anything odd shows up.

release-bot: Exception request logged for PR 5123 by alex. Status: pending human approval.

elaine: Approving this exception now based on tests and rollback plan. Merge when green.

alex: merging now. thanks all.

ci-bot: merge + deploy pipeline started for main -> canary. build #988 queued.
